summary: Churchill Capital Corp XII filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its initial public offering of 41,400,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $414 million. Each unit consists of one Class A share and one-tenth of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50. The company also entered into underwriting, warrant, and investment management agreements. This is a routine SPAC IPO closing disclosure, not a special situation such as a business combination or de-SPAC transaction. No target, premium, or deal vote is involved.
